newsitem.title: USA: Schweitzer sees Q2 EPS above analysts views.
newsitem.headline: Schweitzer sees Q2 EPS above analysts views.

text.p: Schweitzer-Mauduit International Inc said second quarter earnings per share will exceed analysts' estimates.
The First Call consensus EPS estimates range from $0.70 to $0.73 per share versus second quarter earnings in 1996 of $0.65 per share.
The company said earnings will exceed $0.73 per share.

"Volume gains achieved in the quarter were driven by our overseas business," chairman and chief executive officer Wayne Deitrich said in a press release. "Our earnings also continued to benefit from improved mill operations, compared to the prior year quarter, reflecting gains from our capital spending program."

"The second quarter expected to be our strongest quarter of the year, as it was in 1996," he said. "Our customers in the United States traditionally reduce their operating schedules around holidays during the third and fourth quarters, which could soften the demand for our products."
